page_title: OSA 2-0 ESP | Osasuna v Espanyol 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Espanyol quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+4' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' 2 - 0 Raul Garcia (Osasuna) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Joan Garcia with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
90' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
89' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) will deliver the corner kick.
86' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
83' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Alex Kral (Espanyol) replaces Urko Gonzalez.
83' Substitution. Omar El Hilali did his best and is replaced by Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol).
82' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
81' A yellow card for a tackle by Jesus Areso (Osasuna). Francisco Maeso doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
80' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abel Bretones is coming onto the pitch as Kike Barja (Osasuna) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' Ante Budimir will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
76' Looks like Kike Barja (Osasuna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
75' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Javi Puado and he is replaced by Jofre (Espanyol).
73' It's time for a substitution. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) comes on in place of Bryan Zaragoza.
73' A cooling break is underway.
72' The attendance for today's match is 21131.
72' Sergio Herrera pulls off a great save to deny Javi Puado (Espanyol), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
71' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.

67' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the roof of the net, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a great save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.
65' Exposito (Espanyol) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
62' Kike Barja (Osasuna) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) for Pablo Ibanez.
60' Here comes a substitution. Kike Barja is brought on as a substitute for Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
58' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Herrera, who smothers the ball.
57' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
55' Here comes a substitution. Pol Lozano is given a rest as he is replaced by Alejo Veliz (Espanyol).
54' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' Pere Milla (Espanyol) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
50' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
49' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
48' Javi Puado (Espanyol) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
46' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Antoniu Roca walks off the pitch to be replaced by Pere Milla (Espanyol).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Francisco Maeso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
44' The corner from Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) is cleared away by the defence.
42' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
41' Espanyol take a short corner kick.

41' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Sergio Herrera guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but Joan Garcia comes off his line to gather the ball.
37' Exposito (Espanyol) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Sergio Herrera.
35' Rough tackle by Lucas Torro (Osasuna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
33' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post.

32' What a poor attempt! Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
30' Today's referee Francisco Maeso rightly decides to book Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) for his harsh tackle.
27' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
24' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
22' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) tackles a bit over-zealously and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul.
20' Exposito (Espanyol) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
17' 1 - 0 Ante Budimir (Osasuna) reacts quickly in the penalty area and scores with aplomb, giving the goalkeeper no chance!
15' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
13' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
11' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Javi Puado (Espanyol) is adjudged offside.
7' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner but it's cleared.
6' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
5' Corner kick. Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is ready to send the ball into the box.
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.

5' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Ante Budimir (Osasuna), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
4' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Javi Puado (Espanyol) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Espanyol will have the kick-off.
